stem.text: A uniform rigid beam of length $3.2\,\text{m}$ is pivoted at its centre. Two children sit at the opposite ends of the beam, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a beam pivoted at its centre on a triangular support, with a child at each end. Labels: child mass 24 kg on the upper left, pivot, 3.2 m for the length of the beam, 20 degrees marked at the lower end, and child mass 36 kg on the right. The beam is shown resting on the horizontal ground at its right-hand end.

stem.text: One child has a mass of $24\,\text{kg}$. The other child has a mass of $36\,\text{kg}$. The heavier child causes one end of the beam to permanently rest on the ground, so that the beam makes an angle of $20^{\circ}$ to the horizontal ground.
What is the moment of the weight of the $24\,\text{kg}$ child about the pivot?
